claims.text: The proposed model combines a gating mechanism with tensor products to improve learning of long-term dependencies and interactions between input and hidden layers.
The architecture uses a Recursive Neural Tensor Network (RecNTN) that incorporates both tensor products and gating mechanisms for enhanced performance.
